tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and screen background. Everything sits on this.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the trade ticket, table rows. One step above surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Input backgrounds and inset wells on surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken. 15:1 light, 15:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, table headers on surface and surface-raised. 5.3:1 light, 7.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders between rows and around cards. Decorative only; never the sole carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders and dividers that must be seen. 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The Handoff teal. Logo bars, links, secondary buttons, selected tabs, focus ring. As text on surface: 6.3:1 light, 7.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind brand text: selected rows, info chips, the sell ticket header.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: The handoff moment. Primary action button fill, the one accent per screen. As text on surface: 5.0:1 light, 8:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-ember
tokens.usage: Text on an ember fill.

tokens.name: ember-bright
tokens.usage: The token disc in the logo mark only. Never text, never a button.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Verified, filled, acknowledged. Text on surface and on good-soft. Always paired with a word or check icon.

tokens.name: good-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a good chip or row highlight. Text on it is good.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Pending, outside band, attention. Text on surface and on warn-soft.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a warn chip. Text on it is warn.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Blocked, reverted, unverified. Text on surface and on bad-soft. Differs from good in lightness, not only hue.

tokens.name: bad-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a bad chip or the blocked state panel. Text on it is bad.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus ring, 2px offset, on every interactive element. 3:1 on all surfaces.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Pitch slides and marketing only. Never inside the wallet screen.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Screen titles in the issuer console.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Sheet and card titles inside the wallet screen.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Asset names, row titles, button labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Demo en Fuji con atestaciones de demostración.
styles.usage: Secondary lines under a row title, disclaimers, helper text. Color ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels and table headers. Color ink-muted.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Every price, quantity and balance in a row. Tabular by nature of the face.

styles.name: amount-l
styles.usage: The headline balance on the market screen.

styles.name: hash
styles.usage: Addresses and transaction hashes, always truncated to 4+4.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, between a row title and its caption.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside chips and small buttons, gap between rows in a list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, screen side gutter on phone.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a screen.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section padding in the issuer console.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top padding of a screen, gap between major blocks on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Logo bar ends at 64px, small chips, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, list rows, inputs on phone.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the trade ticket.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and the account badge.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The bottom sheet only. Cards use line, not shadow.
